highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Southeast Missouri State University (often called SEMO) is a regional university that offers you personalised education with real-world readiness. The university provides nearly 120+ undergraduate and 30+ postgraduate programmes.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: At SEMO, you’ll be part of a close and supportive community, with many events, 270+ student organisations and programmes. Plus, you’ll be in a thriving location in downtown Cape Girardeau, filled with cafes, markets, riverfront views, and more.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
At SEMO, you can choose from 12 on-campus living options, including community housing and suite-style residences. Common amenities include computer access, cable TV, common and private bathrooms, kitchens, and more. Not just that, all on-campus housing contracts include meal service, which includes a certain number of meals each week.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
At SEMO, you’ll find the Kent Library along with the SEMO Online support, which helps you with your study resources, career services, IT support, counselling, research databases, and more.

Sports
SEMO has many athletic spaces, featuring the Houck Stadium, Houck Field House, the Holcomb Success Centre, and the Rosengarten Athletic Complex. You can participate in intramural sports and club sports.

Laboratory
Beyond classes, you’ll find several lab facilities, including the Allied Health, Kinesiology & Sport Sciences labs, Engineering & Technology labs, and Agriculture & Environmental Research spaces.

Cafeteria
On campus, you’ll have several spots for food, including the Copper Dome Cafe, Panda Express, and the Redhawks Market.
